title: Assets
description: Serve images, downloads and uploads from your own S3-compatible bucket. Levelrail never stores the files.

connect.title: Connect a bucket
connect.description: Pick a storage destination you already added. Files stay in that bucket.
connect.name: Name
connect.nameHint: 2 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
connect.prefixHint: Optional folder inside the bucket. A prefix is not a security boundary.
connect.publicBaseUrlHint: Where the bucket is readable, for example https://assets.example.com.
connect.cdnBaseUrlHint: The CDN in front of the bucket. Required for CDN serving.
connect.confirmName: Type the bucket name to make it public

empty.title: No asset buckets yet
empty.description: Connect a bucket to upload files, copy their URLs and see what they cost.

detail.disconnectBody: This removes the connection from Levelrail only.
detail.disconnectKeeps: Files in the provider bucket are not deleted.

items.title: Files
items.empty: Nothing here yet. Upload a file to get a URL.
items.loadFailed: Could not list files. Run the check on the right.
items.signedNote: Signed links expire. Make the bucket public for permanent URLs.
items.deleteBody: The file is removed from the bucket.

probe.title: Connection check
probe.corsApplied: CORS rule added to the bucket.
probe.manualTitle: Add this CORS rule at your provider
probe.manualBody: The key cannot change bucket CORS. Paste this rule in the provider console, then run the check again.

access.title: Access and serving
access.publicBody: Public buckets hand out permanent URLs that anyone can open.
access.publicRisk1: Anyone with a link can download every file you serve.
access.publicRisk2: Search engines and scrapers can find public files.
access.publicRisk3: Egress costs are billed to you by the provider.
access.publicRisk4: The change is written to the audit log.
access.privateBody: Existing public links stop being handed out. The provider may still serve them until you close public access there.
access.noProxied: Proxied serving is not available here.

usage.title: Usage and cost
usage.egressHint: Levelrail does not see downloads from the bucket, so enter the traffic you expect.
usage.priceDate: List prices from {{date}}. Request charges are not included.
